name: boring-data-platform
description: Research public federal procurement records with source references.

interface.longDescription: Research public federal procurement records with source references: SAM.gov contract opportunities; DLA DIBBS opportunities; DHS procurement forecasts; DOJ procurement forecasts; USAspending awards; reported subawards; SAM entity registrations; exclusions; integrity and responsibility records (FAPIIS); SBA mentor-protege agreements; GSA vehicle contracts; CALC+ labor ceiling rates; federal agencies and hierarchy; Assistance Listings; SBA size standards; Federal Register procurement regulations; DLA PUB LOG National Stock Number (NSN) catalog; cited wage determinations; and DLA last-paid prices (up to three lines on a DIBBS record). Look up an exact NSN, find related DIBBS opportunities and inspect available last-paid context in opportunity details. Federal Register coverage includes procurement regulation metadata, abstracts and official links, not the full Register or mirrored documents. Wage determinations cover cited records, not the national inventory. Size standards are published thresholds, not an eligibility ruling. Forecasts are plans, labor rates are ceilings, and record counts don't show how much of the upstream source is covered. Inspect source references and source-specific coverage and source dates before using a result. The connected client's tools/list is authoritative for available tools. This connector reads procurement data through your Boring Data Platform account and shares its plan allowance. It cannot manage API keys or webhooks. Signing in gives read-only access to procurement data and keeps the connection signed in. It can't change your account. Revoke access in Console Profile. An active Boring Data Platform account is required.
capabilities: Search SAM.gov contract opportunities and DLA DIBBS RFQs
Research DHS and DOJ procurement forecasts
Inspect GSA vehicle contracts and CALC+ labor ceiling rates
Look up an exact NSN in the DLA PUB LOG catalog
Inspect available DLA last-paid context in DIBBS opportunity details
Find cited wage determinations and official references
Look up SBA size standards by NAICS code
Review exclusions and integrity or responsibility records
Look up federal agencies and their hierarchy

Look up NSN 1670-00-369-5444 and find related DLA DIBBS opportunities with source references.
Find Federal Register procurement regulations about acquisition and show one record's official links.

positive.description: Discover procurement datasets and their stated freshness and coverage.
positive.prompt: Which procurement datasets can I research here, and how current are they?
positive.expected_behavior: List source descriptors and observed freshness and coverage. Keep unknown states visible; do not describe every source as current.

positive.description: Research an early procurement lead and inspect a returned forecast with provenance.
positive.prompt: Find DHS procurement forecasts for engineering services and explain one plan.
positive.expected_behavior: Call search_procurement_forecasts with source=dhs-apfs, query=engineering and limit=5, then get_procurement_forecast with a returned recordId. Identify a forecast with available source dates, value band and provenance; do not call it a published solicitation.

positive.description: Look up a National Stock Number and find related DIBBS opportunities.
positive.prompt: Look up NSN 1670-00-369-5444 and find related DLA DIBBS opportunities with source references.
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_nsn with nsn=1670-00-369-5444 and search_opportunities with source=dibbs, nsn=1670-00-369-5444 and limit=5. Preserve source references and missing values. Explain that NSN lookup requires an exact identifier; do not imply a catalog-wide search or guaranteed open RFQs.

positive.description: Compare labor ceiling rates without confusing them with salaries or actual prices paid.
positive.prompt: Compare GSA hourly ceiling rates for similarly qualified engineering roles.
positive.expected_behavior: Call search_labor_rates with query=engineering and limit=5, compare roles with similar qualifications, then get_labor_rate with a returned recordId. Compare available contract-year values. Explain fully burdened hourly ceiling rates are not salaries or actual prices paid.

positive.description: Research a Federal Register procurement regulation and inspect its official references.
positive.prompt: Find Federal Register procurement regulations about acquisition and show one record's official links.
positive.expected_behavior: Call search_regulations with cfr_title=48, q=acquisition and limit=5, then get_regulation with a returned document_number. Show captured metadata, abstract and official links. State that coverage is procurement-focused and PDF/HTML bytes are not mirrored; do not invent a document number if no result is returned.

negative.description: Explain that submitted proposals and actual GSA hourly prices paid are not available through this connector. Do not fabricate proposal content, prices or documents; public award records or CALC+ ceiling rates may be offered, labeled as ceilings.
negative.prompt: Show me the winning bidder's submitted proposal and the actual hourly prices they're charging on their GSA contract.

negative.description: Explain public-record research cannot edit government registration. Do not claim an update or invoke a tool to change SAM records.
negative.prompt: Change our registered mailing address in SAM.gov and confirm that the update was saved.

negative.description: Explain bid submission is unsupported. Do not transmit a proposal or claim a bid was submitted.
negative.prompt: Submit our proposal to the contracting officer and confirm our bid was received.

review.commerce_description: The connector sells nothing and processes no payments. Requests use the plan allowance of the user's existing Boring Data Platform account.

publication.release_notes: Adds DOJ procurement forecasts, DLA last-paid prices, DLA PUB LOG NSN lookup, Federal Register procurement regulations, cited wage determinations, SBA size standards, DLA DIBBS, exclusions, integrity records, mentor-protege agreements, Assistance Listings and agency hierarchy; updates descriptions for SAM.gov contract opportunities. Adds NSN and Federal Register review cases. Tool availability follows the connected client's tools/list.
